narrative: Two-factor authentication code sent upon your login request.

message.body: Your 2FA login code is 492-018. If you did not initiate a login, please change your password on the app settings immediately.

evidence.label: Trigger Event
evidence.value: Sent immediately after you entered your password on your laptop

evidence.label: Message Text
evidence.value: Standard 2FA format; does not ask to forward code

evidence.label: Laptop Login Screen
evidence.value: Login screen is actively waiting for 6-digit 2FA input.

consequence_text.safe: You entered the code into your active login session securely.
consequence_text.unsafe: Ignoring 2FA codes that you personally requested prevents you from logging in.

teaching_point: 2FA codes requested by your own actions are genuine and safe to enter on your login prompt.
